failure_summary.description: Agents used an unavailable cache result, searched instead of refining a compatible result, or skipped applying the latest filter.
Agents omitted required result binding and saving, or saved a retrieved result instead of the result of the required tool action.
Agents mapped a state abbreviation to the city field or added an unrequested restaurant preference.

patch.reasoning: These failures already conflict with explicit skill instructions: use only listed compatible cache results, apply new constraints as refinements, save exact tool returns, map regions to state, and avoid inferred preferences. The protected section also prohibits imports. Adding another reminder would duplicate existing guidance rather than patch a skill gap.
